name: nGZGraphic4::cPixelFormatsManagerDX::Construct
notes: Constructor (no arguments). Builds the id map and the sorted vector from the 56-pointer table at 0xd9cf78 (index, object, constructor and arguments of all 56 static formats are in kStatics in the test: 51 .bss objects built by one initialiser thunk each in 0x136e60-0x1383b4, the five DXT objects constant-initialised in .data at 0xfec0b4). Differential: compares vtable, map (max load factor, bucket count, entries in iteration order), and the sorted vector (contents and capacity). Mutation check (tools/mutate.py --filter PixelFormatsManager_, 17 mutants: sort/equal_range strictness, map/vector teardown, id slot, QueryInterface ids, unknown fallback, Release/QueryInterface of the match, argument order of each lookup, vtable store): all killed except two reviewed as unobservable (mById[id]= vs emplace differs only for duplicate ids, which the fixed game table lacks; the stack key temporary leaks its heap name only for names over 15 characters, not visible without allocator hooks). Hooked in src/hook/tables/PixelFormatsManager.cpp; not yet run in-game. Wave A: the manager's vtable is ours too (ManagerVTable); it reads its 56 formats and unknown format from the PixelFormatStore (StandaloneStore: our own objects; ImageStore in-game: the image's storage, constructed by our hooked constructors). Test: ours runs over our own statics, the original over the image's (built by the image's own static initialisers), results compared as table indexes; PixelFormatsManager_ImageStore covers the in-game configuration. Mutation check (tools/mutate.py build/pixelformat_mutants.json, filter PixelFormat, 36 mutants, all killed): wrong function in a class/BaseT/manager vtable slot, swapped slot pairs (ARGB 11/12, 15/16, ABGRFloat 13/14, DXT 15/16, AlphaLuminance 9/10, YUV 6/8, manager 4/5 and 8/9), _purecall and ReturnOne exchanged, constructors/destructor templates writing the wrong vtable, wrong static spec/table order/DXT ids/unknown name, ImageStore adoption/RVAs/CreateIterator, manager dtor/CreateIterator forwarding. The old per-function tests alone (filter PixelFormat_) let the slot mutants survive; the slot tests kill them. The exit status of pixelformat_check.exe also fails (exit 1) for a changed DXT GetRowBytes, and a GameAddress use in PixelFormat.cpp fails to link (LNK2019 GameBase).
